description: Reliability-first observability for Echolex: Linux host, NVIDIA GPU/VRAM, vLLM LLM/STT, vLLM-Omni TTS and combined inference fleet health. Exact last-request latency is intentionally not inferred from Prometheus histograms.

panels.title: Model scrape health
panels.description: 1 means every vLLM/vLLM-Omni target is being scraped successfully.

panels.title: Infrastructure scrape health
panels.description: Host, GPU exporter and Qdrant scrape health.

panels.title: Running requests · all models
panels.description: Current requests executing across all inference services.

panels.title: Waiting requests · all models
panels.description: Current queue depth across all inference services.

panels.title: Request throughput · all models

targets.expr: (sum(rate(vllm:request_success_total{job=~"vllm-(llm|stt)"}[1m]) or rate(vllm:request_success{job=~"vllm-(llm|stt)"}[1m])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(vllm_omni:requests_success_total{job="vllm-tts"}[1m]) or rate(vllm_omni:requests_success{job="vllm-tts"}[1m])) or vector(0))

panels.description: Completed request throughput across LLM, STT and TTS.

panels.title: Preemptions / min
panels.description: Scheduler preemptions across standard vLLM engines. Sustained non-zero values indicate resource pressure.

panels.title: CPU utilization
panels.description: Busy CPU time across all logical cores.

panels.title: Host RAM used
panels.description: System RAM used percentage based on MemAvailable.

panels.title: GPU compute utilization
panels.description: Maximum GPU utilization among selected GPUs.

panels.title: VRAM used
panels.description: Total selected-GPU framebuffer memory used percentage.

panels.title: Fleet KV cache · max
panels.description: Maximum KV-cache utilization across selected standard vLLM models. Max is used instead of average so a saturated model is not hidden.

panels.title: GPU temperature · max
panels.description: Maximum GPU temperature among selected GPUs.

options.content: **Exact values for the last completed request are not retained by stock Prometheus histograms.** TTFT, E2E, TPOT, queue, prefill, decode and per-request token counts are therefore shown as **recent mean (1 minute)**, **rolling mean (5 minutes)** and/or percentiles. Current gauges such as running requests, waiting requests and KV-cache usage are exact at scrape time. To display the literal last request, emit request-level metrics/logs/traces from the caller or a request-aware proxy with a request ID and completion timestamp; do not infer it from histogram buckets.

panels.title: CPU temperature · max
panels.description: Maximum CPU-related hwmon/thermal-zone sensor when exposed by the Linux host.

panels.title: CPU logical cores
panels.description: Logical processors visible to the host exporter.

panels.title: CPU busy cores
panels.description: Equivalent number of logical CPU cores currently busy over the last minute.

panels.title: Load average · 1m
panels.description: Linux 1-minute load average. Compare it with logical core count.

panels.title: CPU utilization and busy-core pressure
panels.description: CPU utilization trend. Use the busy-core stat above to convert percentage into effective cores.

panels.title: CPU temperature sensors
panels.description: No data is expected if the host/WSL2 VM does not expose thermal sensors into /sys.

panels.title: CPU load average
panels.description: Linux scheduler load, useful for detecting CPU-side backpressure around tokenization, audio processing and data movement.

panels.title: 02 · NVIDIA GPU · VRAM, compute, thermal and PCIe
VRAM · total
panels.description: Used + free + reserved framebuffer memory.

panels.title: GPU utilization
panels.description: DCGM device utilization (%).

panels.title: Compute-engine active
panels.description: Profiling ratio for graphics/compute engine active time. Hardware/driver support is required.

panels.title: Tensor-pipe active
panels.description: Tensor-pipe active ratio when supported by the GPU.

panels.title: DRAM active
panels.description: Fraction of cycles with device-memory traffic, when profiling metrics are supported.

panels.title: GPU and memory temperature
panels.description: Use this with throttling panels below to distinguish high temperature from actual thermal limiting.

panels.title: PCIe bandwidth
panels.description: DCGM profiling PCIe bandwidth. These fields are hardware/driver dependent; N/A is valid when unsupported.

panels.title: GPU clocks
panels.description: Clock drops during load can indicate thermal or power throttling.

panels.title: Last GPU XID code
panels.description: 0 / N/A is normal. A non-zero XID code should be correlated with driver logs and NVIDIA XID documentation.

panels.title: Pending retired pages
panels.description: 1 means a GPU page is pending retirement.

panels.title: PCIe replays · last 5m
panels.description: Growth can indicate PCIe link integrity or transport issues.

panels.title: ECC double-bit errors · last 5m
panels.description: Uncorrectable/double-bit ECC errors are a high-priority hardware reliability signal.

panels.title: GPU throttling pressure
panels.description: Percent of wall time spent under a DCGM limiter over the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: GPU reliability events
panels.description: Non-zero double-bit ECC or sustained PCIe replay growth deserves investigation.

panels.title: 03 · All models combined · scheduler and throughput
Preemptions · total
panels.description: Cumulative scheduler preemptions since process start.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(vllm:request_success_total{job=~"vllm-(llm|stt)"}[1m]) or rate(vllm:request_success{job=~"vllm-(llm|stt)"}[1m])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(vllm_omni:requests_success_total{job="vllm-tts"}[1m]) or rate(vllm_omni:requests_success{job="vllm-tts"}[1m])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Output-token throughput
panels.description: Standard vLLM generation-token throughput; TTS audio is tracked separately.

panels.title: Running and waiting requests · all models

targets.expr: (sum(rate(vllm:request_success_total{job=~"vllm-(llm|stt)"}[1m]) or rate(vllm:request_success{job=~"vllm-(llm|stt)"}[1m])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(vllm_omni:requests_success_total{job="vllm-tts"}[1m]) or rate(vllm_omni:requests_success{job="vllm-tts"}[1m])) or vector(0))

panels.title: KV-cache utilization · per model
panels.description: KV cache is a token-model metric; TTS audio serving may use a different cache model.

panels.title: Scheduler preemptions
panels.description: Sustained preemptions usually indicate KV/cache or scheduling pressure.

panels.title: Waiting requests · reason
panels.description: If supported by the installed vLLM version, distinguishes capacity waits from requests deferred by transient constraints.

panels.title: 04 · Per-model latency · TTFT, E2E, TPOT and ITL
TTFT · recent mean 1m
panels.description: Reliable recent mean; not the literal last request.

panels.title: E2E · recent mean 1m

targets.expr: sum by (model_service) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_sum{job=~"vllm-(llm|stt)",model_service=~"$model"}[1m])) / sum by (model_service) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_count{job=~"vllm-(llm|stt)",model_service=~"$model"}[1m])) or sum by (model_service) (rate(vllm_omni:e2e_request_latency_s_sum{job="vllm-tts",model_service=~"$model"}[1m])) / sum by (model_service) (rate(vllm_omni:e2e_request_latency_s_count{job="vllm-tts",model_service=~"$model"}[1m]))

panels.description: Recent mean across standard vLLM or vLLM-Omni E2E histograms.

targets.expr: sum by (model_service) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_sum{job=~"vllm-(llm|stt)",model_service=~"$model"}[5m])) / sum by (model_service) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_count{job=~"vllm-(llm|stt)",model_service=~"$model"}[5m])) or sum by (model_service) (rate(vllm_omni:e2e_request_latency_s_sum{job="vllm-tts",model_service=~"$model"}[5m])) / sum by (model_service) (rate(vllm_omni:e2e_request_latency_s_count{job="vllm-tts",model_service=~"$model"}[5m]))

panels.title: TPOT · recent mean 1m
panels.description: Per-request time per output token. Applies to engines exposing token metrics.

targets.expr: sum by (model_service) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_sum{job=~"vllm-(llm|stt)",model_service=~"$model"}[5m])) / sum by (model_service) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_count{job=~"vllm-(llm|stt)",model_service=~"$model"}[5m])) or sum by (model_service) (rate(vllm_omni:e2e_request_latency_s_sum{job="vllm-tts",model_service=~"$model"}[5m])) / sum by (model_service) (rate(vllm_omni:e2e_request_latency_s_count{job="vllm-tts",model_service=~"$model"}[5m]))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (model_service, le) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket{job=~"vllm-(llm|stt)",model_service=~"$model"}[5m]))) or histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (model_service, le) (rate(vllm_omni:e2e_request_latency_s_bucket{job="vllm-tts",model_service=~"$model"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (model_service, le) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket{job=~"vllm-(llm|stt)",model_service=~"$model"}[5m]))) or histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (model_service, le) (rate(vllm_omni:e2e_request_latency_s_bucket{job="vllm-tts",model_service=~"$model"}[5m])))

panels.description: Recent mean; not exact last request.

panels.description: Recent mean; not exact last request.

panels.description: Time in the model RUNNING phase, useful alongside queue/prefill/decode to isolate scheduler vs execution delay.

panels.description: Cumulative generated tokens since model-server process start.

targets.expr: sum by (model_service) (rate(vllm:request_success_total{job=~"vllm-(llm|stt)",model_service=~"$model"}[1m]) or rate(vllm:request_success{job=~"vllm-(llm|stt)",model_service=~"$model"}[1m])) or sum by (model_service) (rate(vllm_omni:requests_success_total{job="vllm-tts",model_service=~"$model"}[1m]) or rate(vllm_omni:requests_success{job="vllm-tts",model_service=~"$model"}[1m]))

panels.title: Prompt tokens / request · distribution
panels.description: Prompt length is a major driver of TTFT and prefill cost.

panels.title: Generated tokens / request · distribution
panels.description: Output length is a major driver of E2E latency and decode occupancy.

panels.title: Corrupted / NaN requests
panels.description: Available when vLLM is configured to compute/report NaNs in logits. Any sustained non-zero value is a reliability signal.

panels.title: Configured model and serving parameters

targets.expr: max by (model_service, inference_role, model_repository, model_dtype, model_quantization, max_model_len, max_num_seqs, gpu_memory_utilization, enforce_eager) (up{job=~"vllm-.*",model_service=~"$model"})

panels.description: Static labels are sourced from the Compose Prometheus scrape configuration so the dashboard shows runtime model configuration without hardcoding model names in the dashboard.

panels.title: Audio TTFP · mean 5m
panels.description: Audio time-to-first-packet, the TTS analogue of TTFT.

panels.title: Audio RTF · mean 5m
panels.description: Real-time factor. Below 1 means synthesis is faster than playback.

panels.title: Audio underrun · p95
panels.description: Streaming gaps audible to a listener.

panels.title: Audio real-time factor
panels.description: RTF < 1 is faster than real time; RTF > 1 cannot keep up with playback without buffering.
